full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case is that, Jibon Barua Deputy Director Narcotics Control Directorate, Sitakundu as informant lodged First Information report implicating the accused-petitioner and Johara Begum alias Minu alias Janir Ma under section 19(1). 19 (Kha) 20 and 25 of the Narcotics Control Act, 1990 alleging that on receipt of information that the accused petitioner of South Salimpur sold heroine in Chittagong city and other areas by storing heroine in the house of Minu of Ali Akbar Colony verified into the truth and on 27.11.2005 constituted a raiding party consisting of A.S.I. Nurul Alam and forces of the Division and at about 10 a.m. surrounded the dwelling but of accused Johara Begum consisting of the room including kitchen of bamboo fancying and roof of corrugated iron with west facing door. On search of the accused petitioner engaged in binding heroine in the middle room of the dwelling but in presence of witnesses recovered one packet of heroine weighing about 80 grams from the waist hidder inside lungi crunch also recovered another packet of heroine weighing 44, grams and 2 purias of heroine of 10 grams each in all 144 grams of heroine and one scale and some stone of 50, 20. 10 and 5 grams used for weighment, seized the same as alamots by preparing seizure list signed by witnesses and the informant. The informant sent specimen heroine for chemical examination under seal cover and caught red handed accused petitioner and co-accused Johura Begum and arrested them.
